harmony.note: the master's chords through the cut: a chord may change off the bar line at a join. The final C / Cadd9 chord starts at 11.0, the motif at 11.5.

sections.name: hook
sections.brief: Observant. No drums: a dark drone, a faint heartbeat, the harmony left open; 0.25 s of near-silence before the hit at 4.0.

sections.name: idea
sections.brief: First resolution on C: the logo hit, the motif's question (G-A). The sub pulse begins, half-time.

sections.name: handoff
sections.brief: A pad on G, a soft pulse, the shop's room tone; the interface takes over as the camera enters the tablet.

sections.name: swipes
sections.brief: The swipes are the rhythm: tuned yes (rising, right) and no (falling, left) phrases over a pad and the pulse; no keys.

sections.name: scan
sections.brief: A tonal riser, the pad opens, everything cuts for 0.25 s of air before the 98 %.

sections.name: match
sections.brief: The 98 % bloom on C: the first, smaller peak. A rolled felt chord, a glass shimmer, then calm.

sections.name: resolve
sections.brief: ★ The handshake: the film's one big resolved C chord, full and warm, no cymbal.

sections.name: signature
sections.brief: Cadd9 rings; the motif completes at 46.0; the last 1.5 s are still and the tail fades to true silence.

sfx.note: tension riser, peaks at 3.5 (the light gathers); the picture holds for 0.25 s of air before the hit
★ the light pulses once: a soft pitched ping + low thump
swell landing on the logo hit
★ sub boom + glassy C chord (with upper harmonics for phones) + air; the pulse begins after it
the shop under the hand-off photograph; it gives way to the interface as the camera enters the screen
camera flies into the tablet screen
one tonal riser replaces the eleven counter ticks; it thins to an inhale in the 0.25 s of air before the hit
★ the 98 % bloom: a bright glass C chord and a sub swell, no confetti; the first, smaller peak
the shop returns under the bag and the handshake and rings out under the signature: the opening's room, closing the circle
★ the sonic motif complete: G4 - A4 - C5 - E5 on the held Cadd9
